## Description

Compares ETF market price with intraday indicative value or basket fair value and hedges deviations after accounting for creation/redemption and financing costs.

## Where it may fit

Temporary dislocations in liquid ETFs, especially around stress, stale underlying prices or cross-market trading hours.

## Vehicles

ETF market makers, index-arbitrage desks, institutional ETF liquidity providers.

## Required data

ETF quotes/trades, basket/holdings or indicative NAV, constituent prices, creation unit terms, fees and borrow/financing.

## Caveats

Most creation/redemption arbitrage is capacity- and infrastructure-intensive; retail data seldom captures executable basket prices.
